notes.subject: bet sot, kavap smol
notes.rationale: Proverb: Judah's defenses are a bed too short and a blanket too narrow — protection that cannot cover; literal image kept.

notes.subject: המסכה
notes.rationale: Some read 'covering/blanket' (massekah here), others link to 'poured image' (molten idol); context of lying refuge favors blanket.

translation: Long wanem, bet i sot tumas long man i stretim bodi long en, na kavap i smol tumas long man i rap olgeta insait.

tokens.gloss: long man i rap olgeta insait
